# colincode.org

> colin: a coding agent in a tenki.cloud box, one command away, with auto-resume
> and your choice of inference provider.

colin is a single bash script. An "agent" is a name + harness (claude | codex |
opencode) + inference provider (+ model); each agent has its own sticky tenki
sandbox named after it. colin creates or resumes the sandbox, starts the agent
inside tmux with the provider wired in, and attaches you to it.

## Install

    curl -fsSL https://colincode.org/install.sh | sh

Requires the tenki CLI (https://tenki.cloud) and jq. The raw script is served at
https://colincode.org/colin.

## Commands

    colin                      pick an agent (or create one) and jump into it
    colin new [harness]        create: harness -> provider -> model -> name
    colin <harness> [action]   harness: claude | codex | opencode
    colin <agent> [action]     a specific agent

    up (default)   create or resume the box, start the agent, attach
    ssh            same as up
    shell          plain shell in the box
    run -- <p>     one-shot headless prompt
    status         agent, provider, box state
    provider       switch inference provider (and model)
    model [id]     switch model
    auth           sign in (claude: `claude auth login` in the box) / store key
    down           pause the box (auto-resumed on next command)
    rm             terminate the box and forget the agent
    colin ls       list agents

## Providers

Harness defaults: Anthropic (claude, the only one with Remote Control), OpenAI
(codex), opencode (opencode). Others: Nebius Token Factory, Boundless, Baseten,
Friendli, OpenRouter (all three harnesses; Claude Code loses Remote Control on
any third-party base URL), PrimaLabs (needs PRIMALABS_BASE_URL; no public docs
yet). Nebius has no Anthropic Messages API, so for Claude Code colin runs a
stdlib-only Python translation proxy inside the box (tmux session claude-proxy,
127.0.0.1:8787, port via COLINCODE_PROXY_PORT) that serves /v1/messages with
streaming and tool calls in front of /chat/completions; the agent is pointed at
it. The same path covers any provider that only has an OpenAI-compatible URL. Keys: NEBIUS_API_KEY, BOUNDLESS_API_KEY, BASETEN_API_KEY,
FRIENDLI_TOKEN, OPENROUTER_API_KEY, PRIMALABS_API_KEY in ~/.config/colincode/env.

## Configuration

COLINCODE_HARNESS (claude), COLINCODE_CPU (4), COLINCODE_MEMORY_MB (8192),
COLINCODE_DISK_GB (20), COLINCODE_IMAGE (none), COLINCODE_RESUME_TIMEOUT (3m).

## Links

- Source: https://github.com/opencolin/colincode
